producer_report.summary: The introspection of a rejected or failed job now carries why the verification failed. Before, the model saw only the outcome's one-line reason, so rejections were grouped by that line and not by cause. `event_of_job` now reads the job's stored verification and appends each unmet criterion's text and each blocker or major finding (severity, summary, location) to the event's `what`. Failed checks (`passed=false`) go under a separate "Failed checks (these are checks that ran, not acceptance criteria)" heading, with the name and the end of the output tail. Lists are capped at 8 entries, 400 characters per item and 600 per output tail, with a "(N more not shown)" line. A passing verification, or none, leaves `what` unchanged. A failing verdict with no unmet criterion, blocker or major finding, or failed check says the cause is not in the stored result. `SYSTEM_PROMPT` now says criteria and checks differ and is re-wrapped. The module docs, `defaults-loop.md` §3.3, `decision-sets.md` §5 and `CHANGELOG.md` describe it. The text is not redacted again. The changelog and docs say this and that the check output was redacted when stored. No transcripts, diffs or other jobs' files are read. The full `cargo test --locked`, clippy and fmt all pass.

checks_run.note: 5 new event_of_job tests: unmet criterion plus major finding; failed check kept apart from criteria; no verification or passing verification keeps the old what; failing verdict without details says so; caps.
Fake-model test: the prompt for a rejected job contains the unmet criterion text and the major finding location.
Full workspace run exited 0. I could not read the saved output file (outside the working directory), so I did not count the results.

open_issues: The caps (8, 400, 600) are estimates, not measured against real verification.json files.
I did not run it against the real stored record of job 20261014-170031-2r9b; the CLI test uses a record shaped like it.
mistakes: Two test-scaffolding slips, fixed before finishing: the first test outcome had no totals and failed to load, and a field reassignment on Scenario::default() tripped clippy.
learnings: Records::load marks an outcome of a request job invalid unless `totals` is set; a test outcome needs `crate::scoring::totals(&[], None)`.
Core unit tests can build a real Athena over a throwaway git repo, as run_pin_tests.rs does, so private `event_of_job` is testable without making it pub.
The fake verifier's criterion text is replaced by the reading's criterion text, so the CLI prompt test sees the reading's wording.
The job title is empty when a stored job has no request or reading, so `what` starts with ": " in the core tests.
clippy denies field reassignment after Scenario::default(); use struct-update syntax.
desires: Read access to the tool-results output file, to count test results instead of relying on the exit code.
